ወበሊዐ: በልዐ — and swallowing, devouring (ወ- 'and' + verbal noun of በልዐ; idiom 'violating (an oath)' uncertain)
ጠፍኡ: ጠፍአ — they perished (3mp perfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
ወዝክሮሙኒ: ዝክር — and their memory, too (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ሙ 'their' + enclitic -ኒ)
ኀልቀ: ኀልቀ — it came to an end (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-l-ḳ)
ወአምልኮ: አምልኮ — and worship of (ወ- 'and' + verbal noun of አምለከ, construct)
ወሰጊድ: ሰጊድ — and bowing down, adoration (ወ- 'and' + noun, verbal noun of ሰገደ)
ኢኮኑ: ኮነ — they were not (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, k-w-n)
አማልክተ: አምላክ — gods (noun; plural አማልክት, accusative form)
ወእም: እም — and from, and after (ወ- 'and' + preposition)
ሞተ: ሞተ — he died (3ms perfect, G, m-w-t); ድኅረ ሞተ ሴም 'after Shem died'
ወእምድኅሬሁ: ድኅረ — and after him (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + preposition with 3ms suffix -ሁ)
ወእሉሰ: እሉ — and these, indeed (ወ- 'and' + demonstrative pl. + emphatic -ሰ)
ያሰግሉ: አሰገለ — they serve, worship (3mp imperfect, causative አ- stem; root s-g-l, uncertain)
ጣዖታተ: ጣዖት — idols (noun; plural ጣዖታት, accusative form)
ወየሐውሩ: ሖረ — and they go (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
ወይገብሩ: ገብረ — and they make (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, g-b-r)
ወይትናገሮሙ: ተናገረ — and he would speak with them (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect, reciprocal ተ- stem, n-g-r; + -ሮሙ 'them')
ወይብሎሙ: ብህለ — and he says to them (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect ይብል + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
ዘታፈቅር: ፈቀረ — whom you love (ዘ- 'whom' + 2ms imperfect, G, f-ḳ-r)
ወይዘብሑ: ዘበሐ — and they sacrifice (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, z-b-ḥ)
ወአዋልዲሆሙ: ወለት — and their daughters (ወ- 'and' + plural አዋልድ + -ሆሙ 'their')
ወይክዕዉ: ከዐወ — and they pour out (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, k-ʿ-w)
ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
ለርኩሳን: ርኩስ — to the unclean (ለ- 'to' + adjective, plural ርኩሳን)

__broaden__.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
__broaden__.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest')
